in_marathi.name: Aravindh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aravindh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aravindh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'aravind' meaning 'peaceful' and 'indh' meaning 'radiant'. This name is associated with the Sun God, Indra, and is considered to be a divine and powerful name in Hindu mythology.
